classes.name: tiles
classes.reason: tiles are read ahead of need by a separate multiprocessing.Process (_prefetch) that fills a bounded queue while the main rank overlaps that work with its own compute and masks access, so no rank stalls on the tile read itself except via the queue depth buffer, and other ranks/processes keep working independently rather than waiting at a barrier.

classes.name: masks
classes.reason: in measure(), the main loop calls probe.read_staged(path_for(...,'masks',...)) synchronously each iteration and only proceeds to sleep_seconds(compute_s) after it returns, so the main rank stops and waits for each masks read while the prefetch worker process continues its own tiles work unaffected.
